title: Sweetheart (IS2026)
synopsis:
Young Nico is a tech-savvy, hyper-connected kid. When his babysitter takes time off to get married, he is forced to spend the summer holiday in Sicily with his solitary, religious, and eccentric aunt. In a world without Wi-Fi, navigating the gap between modernity and the past, speed and slowness, Nico stares at the portrait of Jesus on the wall, explores his aunt’s past, and shares secrets with the girl next door. He gradually learns to find joy in his own company, ultimately forging an unexpected bond with his aunt that neither knew they needed. 

 

Locarno Film Festival - Filmmakers of the Present: Special Jury Prize and Best Performance

David di Donatello Awards: Best Actress and Best New Director

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
小男孩 Nico 習慣了機不離手、時刻在線的生活，無奈保姆放假結婚，被迫前往西西里島，與獨居、虔誠又脾氣古怪的姑媽度過暑假。在這個沒有網絡的世界，身處現代與傳統、科學與宗教的衝撞中，Nico 對着耶穌畫像發呆，在家裏探索姑媽的過去，和隔壁的女孩分享秘密⋯⋯在充滿傳說和迷信的土地上漸漸學會自得其樂，更與姑媽萌生出一段彼此都未曾察覺、原來一直渴望的深厚情感。
